notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!

I finally finished remaking Lofi Ping Pong from scratch! It took a lot of late nights after work, so I really hope it's actually better now and that all that effort wasn't wasted.
So, patch notes! ːHorseː[/p][p]
[b]Game design[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can miss 3 times before you lose[/p][/*][*][p]You can combine mods (e.g. wind + two balls)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fresh new UI[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Technical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Calibration[/p][/*][*][p]Key rebinding[/p][/*][*][p]5 new languages[/p][list][*][p]Chinese Traditional[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Serbian[/p][/*][*][p]Vietnamese[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Autoplay[/p][/*][*][p]Wide screens support[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Cloud[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 2 new tracks from Hamiko[/p][/*][*][p]Added “OG” achievement for completing the story without misses[/p][/*][/list][p]Big shout-out to the awesome folks on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/PGcAZCh" style="button" buttoncolor="#8080ff"]Discord[/url] who helped test this version. Thanks to you, it's much more polished than it would have been otherwise.[/p][p]That said, I'm sure there are still bugs lurking around and plenty of room to improve. So please report anything weird you find, and don't be shy about suggesting new features or changes![/p][p]Thanks so much for playing![/p]

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Earlier this spring LFPP came out. I made several patches and one major update (Speed increase). Then I said to everyone and myself that I will stop updating LFPP because I got kinda busy with other stuff.
But [i]Ima hooligan[/i] and wanna break the rules so here you go - an update. Honestly, I just wanted to distract myself a little bit from a new project that I am making now. I am not planning to patch the game (only if this update will have some bugs) and will continue making new game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/a35b02a2bb59b89791db6c487837b7d83fea4782.png[/img]

So, what's new?
New location - attic. It won't appear in Story mode, just in Free play. It has a new gameplay feature - after several hits 3 balls appear on the table, where 2 of them are fake.
Also, 4 new songs are added from our old friends Zmeyev and Satoruu.
You can check new map on the video below.

I hope you like it, it was fun to return to LFPP once again.
[strike]but it was pain to read an old code[/strike]

Also Discord https://discord.gg/R2qbVNx

[previewyoutube=_31wcZZoUrs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update Patch #4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] You can now change the speed of your songs from 100% to 150%! You can increase it gradually (e.g. from 110 to 120) or set it to persistent (e.g. 130 to 130). This how it will look [url=https://youtu.be/Rdkp8wXvd9U]CLICK[/url] (Youtube)
[*] Norwegian language was added (thanks to shi)
[*] French language was fixed (thanks to LeDieuOrnithorynque)
[*] Uploaded OST - [url=https://youtu.be/06Ml9ny0doY]CLICK[/url] (Youtube)
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34644940/0cc703b175d0a103e727c11aecad7cc7a1ec502c.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Scoring system changes - now you will get more points for faster songs, rather than longer
[*] Fixed the Wind mode (it is more precise now and the ball changes the direction later)
[*] Now 3,2,1 is counted in the song's rhythm
[*] While editing your track you can move the left border not only by 0.05 sec, but by 0.01 sec
[*] You can now see the score in NoFail mode (NOTE: the score from NoFail still won't go to the Leaderboards)
[*] Added Simplified Chinese (thanks to Nyko_Saire). A Traditional Chinese should be added later. Note, that I used different Draw system for Chinese and some things may won't work as intended. If you find such things, please write to the Community Hub or to our Discord server
[/list]

Don't forget that we have a Discord server https://discord.gg/mD6tHDE

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34644940/c917974f98532046c12296c40104676a872228c0.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] You can delete songs that you've uploaded by pressing Del
[*] You can now play with WASD
[*] If you want to upload a file that's already exists in your playlist, it will upload but the name will be changed to "1/song_name/"
[*] The central stripe on the table is almost transparent now so it will be easier to hit ball when it flies from center to center
[*] Added Polish language (thanks to Kiran)
[/list]

I will now work on Leaderboard system.
Don't forget that we have a Discord server https://discord.gg/mD6tHDE

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34644940/f2055724b4a4a1f362e422baa0b3b0e2609d66c1.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
Not that great changes, but still:
[list]
[*] [i]Kinda[/i] fixed the grading system (it was always S+)
[*] Girl didn't move every second hit when playing fast song on Double ball
[*] When editing track, BPM thresholds were from 50 to 300, now they are from 60 to 250
[*] Other small fixes, including visuals
[/list]
